product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps brands and businesses create, manage, and measure links and QR codes that connect audiences across online and offline channels.

employee_band.notes: Company size reported on Bitly's LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include “Why We Write Everything in Go” and “NSQ: realtime distributed message processing at scale,” covering Bitly's implementation and infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal documents link creation, engagement analytics, custom domains, QR-code scans, and other endpoints.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists Director, Website Strategy only; no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role is listed.

model_provider.notes: The underlying provider for Bitly Assist was not identified in the reviewed product documentation, AI FAQ, blog, or public security material. Detailed subprocessor information is supplied on request; compatible AI integrations were not treated as underlying providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The security portal lists SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile dates the round July 12, 2017. Spectrum Equity's investment gave it a majority stake in Bitly.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round was in July 2017, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists Director, Website Strategy only. The former Greenhouse board is inactive, so its cached Account Executive posting was excluded.

launched_6mo.notes: September 2026 releases included per-link AI-traffic analytics and programmatic creation and management of Bitly Pages through the API and MCP.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young's appointment as Chief Technology Officer on March 19, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Qualified's Bitly case study names Salesforce and Marketo integrations and describes Bitly's adoption of Qualified.
